sections.content: Defines the vdd-conformance-exact-cover implementation contract, self-hosted profile, lifecycle state, permitted production and test paths, forbidden areas, dependency ordering, slice behaviors, acceptance mappings, registered green and negative commands, recovery rules, and terminal validation. It requires preserving the typed package and selection registry producer and completing slices S0 through S5.
sections.title: Implementation Contract

sections.content: Defines the normative universe as the typed Canonical Spec Package graph with its companions, adopted Architecture Spine, selection record, and pointer. Requirements are exactly VCEC-001 through VCEC-036 and acceptances exactly VCEC-A01 through VCEC-A43, with authoritative forward and reverse mappings to slices and commands. Historical provenance is non-normative; listed non-goals exclude producer attestation, lifecycle ownership, copied schemas, Chapter 5 dependency, automatic Bootstrap launch, and resume guarantees.
sections.title: Requirements And Acceptance

sections.content: The two supplied sources provide complete page and source coverage for acceptance. The contract and requirements establish deterministic exact-cover behavior, source freezing, semantic handoff, retry and shard policies, recovery context, preflight checks, and terminal dogfood replay within the stated boundaries.
